description: This file defines the class `Topic` in the namespace `Opencart.Admin.Model.Cms`. It provides methods for managing topics, including adding, editing, deleting, retrieving individual or multiple topics, managing descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts related to topics within an OpenCart CMS system. The class interacts with a database, caches, and other models for comprehensive CRUD operations and related data handling.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Represents operational methods for managing CMS topics in the OpenCart administrative backend, including CRUD operations, descriptions, SEO URL management, store affiliations, and layout assignments.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Inserts a new topic record into the database, including associated descriptions, store associations, and SEO URLs. Returns the ID of the newly created topic.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Updates existing topic data, including descriptions, store associations, and SEO URLs based on the specified topic ID.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Removes a topic and all its related data such as descriptions, store associations, and SEO URLs from the database.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific topic by ID, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of topics with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination, considering language and store context.

methods.name: getTotalTopics
methods.description: Returns the total count of topics in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a topic in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all topic descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given topic, keyed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions that match a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a topic with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a given topic.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with a topic for a specific store.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Creates an SEO URL entry for a topic in a specific store and language.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes SEO URLs associated with a specific key and value, e.g., 'topic_id'.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with a specific topic by inserting a record into the 'topic_to_layout' table.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a given content item identified by article_id.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all associations with a specific layout ID from the 'topic_to_layout' table.
